title: Premium animated Evia walkthrough
details: Show me around is now a full-screen guided Evia tour rather than a static phone-style slideshow
Evia floats between the real-style home controls, arches, evidence routes, guided audio, Course Coverage, assessor exchange, Learn and Test
The tour mostly auto-plays like a product video and pauses only for the important learner presses
Spotlights, tap ripples, short speech bubbles and Evia eye expressions show exactly where to press without covering the interface
The existing demo, QR activation, guided audio, targets and full learner behaviour are unchanged
summary: Evia v218 replaces the rough walkthrough with a polished animated product tour that looks and behaves like Evia itself.
changes: Removed the fake phone-card walkthrough presentation
Added curved floating Evia movement between live-style interface areas
Added auto-play scenes with interactive pauses for Evia, evidence, guided audio, Course and Test
Added animated Course Coverage evidence-source examples and QR/OTJ/Test demonstrations
Created a fresh v218 offline cache
